title: [yencoding] Improve docs and comments
description:
Skoll findings for docs/comments in yencoding:
- LOW-56: Document that YencMetadata::line_length defaults to 128 when line= field is absent
- LOW-59: Document that strip_keyword does not trim leading whitespace before keyword lines
- MEDIUM-60: Add comment in encode_body explaining that pre-flush col==0 check correctly handles dot/TAB-at-line-start (escape pair starts with '=' not '.'/'TAB')
- INFO-62: Change 'Safety:' comment in assembler.rs to 'Invariant:' (not an unsafe block)
close_reason: Documented line_length default (128), strip_keyword leading whitespace behavior, encode_body col==0 flush safety, and fixed Safety→Invariant comment.
